title: Food & Drink
heading: Good food. Full bellies. Happy days.
intro: Now we are talking. A bag of chips by the sea, a proper pub lunch or a curry worth making a stop for — good food is part of the adventure. These UK food and drink guides help you find a restaurant, café or takeaway that fits your day, then see what else is nearby. Start with Masala & Malt in Grimsby, Reel Plaice in Ayr or the food stops around your chosen town. Open the individual guide for the story and practical details. Nobody wants the best bit of the day to be a soggy sandwich in the car.
tagline: Places to eat on your day out: cafes, pubs, fish and chips and family-friendly restaurants near UK attractions and seaside towns.
